warnings.headline: Dense fog locally in central part
warnings.description:
Dense fog occurs locally in the central and southern parts of the country.

In dense fog, visibility is less than 200 meters.
warnings.instruction: Drive more slowly and maintain a greater distance from other road users. | Use the correct lights: front fog lights (when visibility is less than 200 metres) and rear fog lights (when visibility is less than 50 metres).
areas: Parts of: Gelderland, Utrecht and North Brabant

warnings.headline: Fog, dense in places, may lead to some travel disruption on Saturday night and Sunday morning
warnings.description:
Patchy, dense fog is expected to develop during Saturday night with the visibility falling to less than 50 metres in places. Fog is expected to become increasingly widespread within this area during the second half of the night before only slowly clearing during Sunday morning; slowest across parts of the West Country and central southern England.

For further details see https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/weather/warnings-and-advice/uk-warnings
warnings.instruction: Give yourself the best chance of avoiding delays by checking road conditions if driving, leaving extra journey time, or amending plans if necessary. Make sure you know how to switch on your fog lights, and check they are working before setting off on your journey. Bus and train services, as well as flights and ferry travel may also be affected; check for updates from your travel company and follow
areas: East Midlands | London & South East England | South West England | West Midlands
